name: program_outputs
description: One output of a program (the full screen now; layout areas later) with its optional default playlist.
lifecycle: Created or updated when the output is saved; deleted with the program (cascade inside the module).

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the program (tenant key).
Output key: screen for a program without a layout, otherwise the key of one of its layout's areas.
Playlist shown when no schedule applies.
columns.Null meaning: The output shows neutral output when no schedule applies.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, default_playlist_id) REFERENCES playlists(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The default playlist belongs to the same company and cannot be deleted while used.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, program_id) REFERENCES programs(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The program belongs to the same company; outputs are deleted with it.
Output keys have the area key shape: a lowercase letter, then up to 15 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX program_outputs_default_idx ON public.program_outputs USING btree (company_id, default_playlist_id)
constraints.Purpose: Finds outputs using a playlist as default, for the playlist delete check.
